integrity: The proof uses exact conic algebra and a convexity/strict-concavity reduction; numerical tests only supplement, and do not certify, the universal theorem. Classical Steiner optimality and earlier inellipse parametrizations are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns nondegenerate ellipses tangent to all three sides of a triangle and a single strictly interior marked point; it is not a theorem about unconstrained ellipses with fewer facet contacts, polygons, or higher-dimensional simplices. Definitive historical priority and independent validation are not established.
title: A cubic law for the largest triangle inellipse containing a marked point
